title: ⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] Eliminate N+1 query in ReceivePurchaseOrder
body:
* 💡 What: Replaced iterative `ReceiveStock` use case invocation inside `ReceivePurchaseOrder` loop with bulk operations (`findBySkus` and `saveAll`) and batched domain event dispatching.
* 🎯 Why: The nested UseCase individually fetched and saved domain entities per iteration, triggering an N+1 database query problem during bulk purchase order receipts, which severely degraded performance.
* 📊 Impact: Transforms N database queries (where N is the number of PO items) into a constant number of queries (O(1)), dramatically reducing query volume, network latency, and memory footprint.
* 🔬 Measurement: Verified via unit tests (`ReceivePurchaseOrderTest.php`) using PHPUnit with mocked batch assertions.
